comparison.objective: Use hedge shears bimanually to cut selected shoots while sparing flowers, then stow the tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Two-handed articulated-tool control, target enclosure, cutting, and obstacle avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: Specified shoots severed at height, flowers uncut, shears closed and returned, and arms withdrawn.
comparison.reason: The record tests selective cutting with a large bimanual tool, not precision mechanism adjustment or commissioning.
